query: I was out walking my golden retriever puppy this morning and he managed to chase a squirrel straight into a patch of dandelions, so now his whole coat is covered in fluffy yellow seeds that I’ve been trying to brush out for the past hour. I also just tried that new iced lavender latte from the coffee shop down the street, and it was way sweeter than I expected, I think I might have to ask for half the syrup next time I go. Oh, and my favorite houseplant that I’ve been tending to for six months finally sprouted a new leaf yesterday, I was so excited I took like ten photos of it to send to my mom. I’m having some issues with my mobile service right now: airplane mode is turned on, my network preferences are acting up, my APN MMS settings seem to be broken, and I think I’ve exceeded my data usage limit, can you help me fix these problems?
